observations: Photo 0 is a small, low resolution shot of a used car automatic gearbox (front wheel drive transaxle) in a pile of other used parts.
The bell housing is open and a blue painted torque converter is fitted.
Alloy casing with dirt and oil staining; a drive shaft output seal is visible at lower left.
A dealer watermark ending in 'SPARE PARTS' covers part of the casing.
No identification plate, transmission code, part number or Toyota marking is readable in photo 0.
The electrical connector is not shown, so the pin count cannot be checked.
No photo of the other sides, the oil pan, the fluid or a test.

identity.kind: used automatic gearbox (front wheel drive transaxle) with torque converter
read_from: photo 0 shape of casing and torque converter only, no plate legible

claims.evidence: No Toyota marking, code plate or part number is readable in photo 0.
Origin cannot be shown by a photo of the casing.
The wiring connector is not visible in photo 0.
Fitment depends on the transmission code, which is not readable in photo 0.
No test clip, fluid photo or warranty terms; priced as not working until shown.

risks.risk: Gearbox is not the claimed Camry unit, for example a different engine or model year code, so it does not fit.
risks.proof: Clear close photo of the identification plate or cast code on the casing showing the transmission model and part number.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot price without it; the transmission code sets the price.

risks.risk: Connector pin count differs from the claimed 22 pin.
risks.proof: Close photo of the main electrical connector with the pins countable.
risks.if_unproven: As not matching the claimed fitment.

risks.risk: Internal wear, slipping clutches or failed solenoids.
risks.proof: Photo of the drained fluid and oil pan magnet, or a clip of the gearbox on a test bench or in a car shifting through all gears.
risks.if_unproven: As not working, rebuild core only.

risks.risk: Cracked casing or broken mounts on sides not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides of the gearbox, including the mounts and oil pan.

risks.risk: Photo is a dealer stock shot of one of many units, not the one sold.
risks.proof: Photo of the code plate next to a paper with the seller's name and today's date.
risks.if_unproven: As the worst unit of this type.

proof_requests: Close photo of the identification plate or cast code on the gearbox casing.
Close photo of the electrical connector showing the pins.
Photos of all sides, mounts and the oil pan.
Photo of the fluid and pan magnet, or a clip of the gearbox shifting in a car or on a bench.
Code plate photo with a dated note from the seller.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transaxle, but no plate or code is readable, and the transmission code is what sets which car it fits and so its price. A clear photo of the code plate is needed before even a worst case price can be set.
